comments: cb555372: This section of the code is responsible for handling the deletion of patient incomplete record entries from the system. It includes initial setup, user prompts for selecting specific records, and the actual deletion process.
819d8363: Start processing delete operation
53d4647a: Check if facility division is set to single division and prompt user to select division if true
feaf2e0e: Set default division if no division is specified
6efbb0b5: Warn user if parameters for delinquency tracking are not set up in the Medical Center Division file
b67bf5f2: Filter for selecting records associated with the specified division
c6eb13dd: Prompt user to select a patient incomplete record to delete
0225caea: Set up variables for viewing the selected incomplete record
2901b93c: Initialize variables for selection and handling of list manager options
d6e048bd: Reset VALMBCK to return control to the list manager
1476a057: Invoke list manager selection utility
db654961: Ensure the full screen mode is enabled and set the return action to 'R' to refresh the list
5191592e: Iterate through selected records for deletion, calling edit utility for each
8f2d8633: Call the report utility before exiting the process
5fd4514d: Prompt user for confirmation before deleting the selected record
5cf47e51: If confirmed, delete the selected record from the database and display a deletion message
fe861dac: Exit without deletion if user selects NO
1aca1fcc: Set flag to indicate user has exited the process
2fd1b1c9: Cleanup and quit the procedure, releasing all used resources
6f4260ce: Display YES/NO prompt instructions to the user
